name: std::swap(std::match_results)
intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::match_results. Exchanges the contents of x1 with those of x2. Effectively calls x1.swap(x2).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x1, x2

 -

 the match_results objects whose contents will be swapped


 Type requirements


 -BidirIt must meet the requirements of LegacyBidirectionalIterator.


 -Alloc must meet the requirements of Allocator.

examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
